errors.evidence: The chart contains 14 distinct slices, not twelve.
The largest slice (17.2%) is colored orange and is labeled "People Blogs", not pink and "People".
The description invents a category named "Blogs" by incorrectly splitting the single label "People Blogs" into two separate categories.
The slice with 9.7% is labeled "Howto Style", not "Blogs". The description hallucinates the "Blogs" category and misassigns the percentage from another category to it.
The slice for "Music" has a value of 2.3%. The value 4.8% corresponds to the "Autos Vehicles" category.

The description incorrectly splits several multi-word labels into individual, non-existent categories (e.g., "News Politics" becomes "News" and "Politics"; "Pets Animals" becomes "Pets" and "Animals").
